subject: Vendor onboarding: Veridian Health — procurement/security package & PO instructions
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@veridianhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <security@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff — Veridian Health

Hi Monica,

We’re ready to start the vendor onboarding for Veridian Health. Procurement has asked for the standard security and privacy artifacts so we can complete our internal review and raise a PO by next Friday (2029-05-03). Can you please provide the following:

- The most recent DPA (preferably e-signable)
- A link to your SOC 2 Type II report or a read-only access path
- Current subprocessor roster (including any cloud infra providers and analytics vendors)
- Instructions for PO submission, billing contact, and invoice routing

Our security contact Tom (cc’d) will review the SOC 2 and subprocessor list — please call out any third parties with EU/UK data residency if applicable.

Thanks — we’d like to confirm timelines today if possible so procurement can slot the PO.

Best,
Sarah Liu
Procurement Manager
Veridian Health
sarah.liu@veridianhealth.com
(415) 555-0124

Attachment: none (we’ll accept documents via DocuSign / secure link)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Apr 2029 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding kickoff — Veridian Health

Hi Sarah — great to hear, and thanks for the timeline.

Quick summary / next steps from our side:
1) DPA: I’m attaching our current DPA for signature (Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf). We prefer DocuSign for execution — link below. If your legal team needs any minor edits we can review, but the standard DPA covers data controller/processor responsibilities and subprocessors.

2) SOC 2: Here is a direct, read-only link to our latest SOC 2 Type II report (redwood_soc2_report_link.txt). For procurement convenience I’ve provided the redacted report link; Tom, if you need the unredacted version we can provision temporary access.

3) Subprocessors: Attached as CSV (redwood_subprocessors_202904.csv). The file includes vendor, purpose, and data residency column. Key items: primary infra is AWS (us-west-2), analytics run on an EU region for customers who opt-in to EU residency.

4) PO & invoicing: We accept POs sent to vendors@redwood.com. Please include your PO number and a billing contact. Default payment terms are Net-30. Invoices should be emailed to billing@redwood.com and cc’d to your Redwood account exec (Ben Carter). If you need a W-9 or vendor form, please attach — our finance team processes the PO once the signed DPA is received.

5) Activation: Once we have a signed DPA and a PO number (or a procurement email confirming intent to issue PO), we’ll kick off the account enablement and send the Statement of Work for implementation scheduling.

DocuSign link for DPA: https://app.docusign.com/link/#!/docusign/ABCDEFG123456789
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/VER-2029-014

Attachments:
- Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf (PDF)
- redwood_subprocessors_202904.csv (CSV)
- redwood_soc2_report_link.txt (TXT pointing to secure drive)

Please confirm whether Veridian needs invoices sent to a specific department or address and whether there are any PO-specific clauses we should be aware of.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Ben for billing/terms clarifications.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Sales Ops (Americas) | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

P.S. Laura — looping you on this one in case procurement needs a copy of the SOW for onboarding scheduling.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Apr 2029 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding kickoff — Veridian Health

Thanks Sarah — Ben here (account exec on VER-2029-014). A couple of clarifying points from the commercial side:

- Standard terms are Net-30 upon receipt of a valid invoice against a PO. If Veridian requires a different payment cadence, let me know and I’ll escalate.
- If you’d like us to include a one-time onboarding credit or expedite activation we can add that to the SOW; I’ve attached a draft SOW for planning (Statement_of_Work_Redwood-Veridian.pdf).

Operational note: we can provision sandbox access prior to PO if needed for integration testing, but production usage requires a signed DPA and a PO number.

If finance needs any additional vendor setup paperwork (W-9, vendor intake form), forward it to vendors@redwood.com and copy me — I’ll triage.

Looking forward to getting things live.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(650) 555-0273

Attachment: Statement_of_Work_Redwood-Veridian.pdf (PDF)

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@veridianhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <security@veridianhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Apr 2029 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding kickoff — Veridian Health

Monica / Ben — thanks for the fast turnaround. Quick updates from our side:

- We will sign the DPA via the DocuSign link today and Tom will review the SOC 2 and subprocessor CSV for any high-risk vendors.
- Procurement will issue PO V-55321 (attached). Please confirm the invoice header we should use and whether you require a vendor portal setup before submitting the invoice.
- We do need a completed vendor onboarding form (attached) for our AP system. I’ve attached the PO as a PDF and the vendor intake form — please return the completed intake to procurement@veridianhealth.com.

Requested info for AP:
- Invoice header / billing address
- Tax ID / W-9 (if US entity)
- Invoice delivery method (email / portal)

We’d like to target production activation the week of 2029-05-06 once the signed DPA and PO are confirmed.

Thanks again — Tom will follow up directly if he needs additional SOC 2 artifacts.

Regards,
Sarah Liu
Procurement Manager
Veridian Health
